glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: Shown while the channel is ahead of the pinned revision.

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: The channel to watch, as it appears under channels.nixos.org - for example nixos-unstable or nixos-25.11.

flake_lock.label: Flake lock
flake_lock.description: The flake.lock holding the revision to compare against.

input.label: Flake input
input.description: Which of the flake's own inputs the channel is compared against. An input that only follows another has no revision of its own.

check_interval_minutes.label: Check interval
check_interval_minutes.description: Minutes between checks. One request per interval, for the whole shell.

update_command.label: Update command
update_command.description: Run in a terminal when the widget is clicked.

show_age.label: Show age
show_age.description: Print how long ago the pinned revision was published beside the glyph.
